system.description: Personal friends or contacts who can be called on for aid between sessions. Each Allies Trait represents one capable person you can rely on. Spending multiple Traits gives an ally extra levels of expertise (one Ability or Influence level per extra Trait spent), and Allies can be used to assist with hunting: each Trait spent on hunting allows a Simple Test, with a win or tie granting one Blood Trait. Allies are not necessarily aware of your vampire nature, and overusing them risks them calling in favors of their own or refusing dangerous requests.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
